data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the iDR unit.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the iDR. Check the host/port and that the unit is switched on and connected to the network.
error.invalid_response: The iDR responded in a way this integration doesn't understand.

abort.already_configured: This iDR unit is already configured.

data.expose_crosspoints: Expose crosspoint gain and mute controls

data_description.inputs: How many of the unit's 16 input channels to expose as entities.
data_description.outputs: How many of the unit's 16 output channels to expose as entities.
data_description.expose_groups: Adds 16 extra entities (8 input + 8 output group gains).
data_description.expose_crosspoints: Adds a gain and a mute entity for every input/output pair in the routing matrix (inputs x outputs x 2) — this can be a lot of entities, see the README.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the unit. Lower values react faster but put more load on the single Telnet connection.

command_failed.message: The iDR did not accept the command: {error}

not_applied.message: Asked the iDR for {requested}, but it reports {actual}. The change may not have been applied.

crosspoint_needs_gain_or_mute.message: Specify a gain, a mute state, or both.

entity_not_found.message: {entity_id} is not a known Allen & Heath iDR entity.

set_crosspoint.name: Set crosspoint
set_crosspoint.description: Sets the gain and/or mute state of a single input/output crosspoint in the routing matrix, even if that crosspoint's own entities are not enabled in the integration's options.

gain.name: Gain
gain.description: Gain in dB (-40 to 0), or "-Inf"/"off" to turn the crosspoint off.

mute.name: Mute
mute.description: Whether the crosspoint should be muted.
